parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. This value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in milliseconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: OrderWay
parameters.description:
The sort order of the list. Valid values:

- asc: ascending order.

- desc: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page. For more information about paging, see the paging parameters.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **5**, which indicates 5 entries per page. For more information about paging, see the paging parameters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. This value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in milliseconds.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of sensitive data. Valid values:

- request: request sensitive data.

- response: response sensitive data.
